_doc: The ride apps Getting around offers (README.md, rules 35 to 39). apps: [{id, name, link}], in the order a guide shows them; link: the app's own plain home address, which sends a phone to the app or its store. No logos, no brand colours. Freenow (added on Yohann's word, 16 Nov 2026, for the taxis) books the town's own taxis; its name as its site writes it today. Read by apps.js's callers: the worker (worker/ride-apps.mjs), the maker (pasted by onboarding-site/src/build.py) and the generator (engine/scripts/apps-of.mjs).
